title: Get the Matte Black!!!
text: Get the Matte Black!!!. Best trash can I have ever owned. The matte black looks great and matches my appliances. Very sturdy, soft-close top, easy to clean.

product_metadata.title: simplehuman 45 Liter / 12 Gallon Slim Hands-Free Kitchen Step Trash Can with Liner Rim, Black Stainless Steel
features: SLIM, SPACE-SAVING SHAPE - Designed to make the most of tight spaces
NEAT AND SECURE - Stainless steel liner rim flips up for a quick and easy liner change, then closes over the liner to hold it tightly in place and keep it hidden from sight
STRONG, STEEL PEDAL - Our strong steel pedal is engineered to last over 150,000 steps — that's more than 20 steps a day for 20 years
SILENT CLOSE LID - Our patented lid shox technology controls the motion of the lid for a slow, silent close
FINGERPRINT-PROOF - Fingerprint-proof finish resists smudges to keep stainless steel shiny

CUSTOM FIT LINERS - Our code N liners are designed to fit this can perfectly so they don't slip, and they stay completely hidden. Extra-thick plastic and double-seam construction prevent rips and tears
description: Our stainless steel slim step can has a space-efficient shape that fits perfectly in tight spots, like between cabinets. The liner rim lifts up for easy access to the liner, then closes to grip and keep it neatly out of sight. The strong steel pedal is built to last, and lid shox technology ensures a smooth, silent close every time.
